LESSON: WRITING 2.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PUNCTUATION MARKS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.5: Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to punctuate a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise the full stop, exclamation mark, and question mark in texts
2. use the full stop, exclamation mark, and question mark in sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 2.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PUNCTUATION MARKS
This lesson teaches Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. recognise the full stop, exclamation mark, and question mark in texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use the full stop, exclamation mark, and question mark in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks above.
2. Explain Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to punctuate a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise the full stop, exclamation mark, and question mark in texts
2. use the full stop, exclamation mark, and question mark in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
